; The same program with @g already inlined into @f, as the inliner leaves it.
; @g is still defined, exactly as it is until dead-function elimination runs.
define internal i32 @g(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %d = mul i32 %v, 3
  %e = add i32 %d, 5
  ret i32 %e
}

define i32 @f(i32 %x) {
entry:
  %g.d = mul i32 %x, 3
  %g.e = add i32 %g.d, 5
  %s = add i32 %g.e, 1
  ret i32 %s
}
